Recommended Settings: Coolest Phone CPU + Best Natural Voice + YouTube Upload

Here is the exact breakdown of which frame rate and which TTS voice keep your phone cool over a 100-chapter (10-hour) batch while giving you natural audiobook narration.

Best Frame Rate: 1.0 FPS (1 Frame/Sec) + 48 kbps Mono AAC

Use 1.0 FPS (or 0.5 FPS max). It cuts 96.6% of video CPU work compared to 30 FPS so your phone never heats up. Going lower (0.1 FPS) saves less than 0.6% storage because 98% of the file is audio, and sub-1-FPS causes YouTube's upload transcoder to get stuck at 95% processing.

Best Low-Resource Natural Voice: Edge Neural (Cloud) or Google Local I/O

1. Microsoft Edge Neural (`en-US-ChristopherNeural` / `GuyNeural`): Generates speech in the cloud—your phone CPU does 0% synthesis work, stays ice-cold, and gets studio YouTube narration.
2. Offline Choice: Android's built-in Google TTS Engine (`en-US-x-iom-local`) using native `synthesizeToFile()`, which runs on Android's low-power DSP.

Step-by-Step: How to Install & Operate on Your Mobile Phone

Method 1 — Instant Web App (30 Seconds)

Install This HTML App on Your Android Phone

  1. Tap the Download / Export button on the Canvas preview panel to save novelfire_audify_studio.html to your phone.
  2. Open the file in Google Chrome on your Android phone.
  3. Tap the 3-dot menu (⋮) in the top-right corner of Chrome and tap Add to Home screen.
  4. Open it from your home screen, paste your chapter text or URL, choose 100 Ch, and tap Start Batch Recording.
Method 2 — Native Android .APK File

Get Your Installable .APK File via Free GitHub Cloud

  1. Download novelfire_audify_android_project.zip from the chat and unzip it on your phone using your Files app.
  2. Log into github.com in your phone browser, tap + → New repository, and upload the unzipped files.
  3. Tap the Actions tab on GitHub—wait 2 minutes for the green checkmark, and download NovelFire-Audify-Studio-APK.zip.
  4. Unzip it, tap app-debug.apk, allow "Install unknown apps", and open the installed app!
